newsitem.title: UK: Pay awards in UK service sector fall in Q1-CBI.
newsitem.headline: Pay awards in UK service sector fall in Q1-CBI.

text.p: Pay awards in Britain's services sector fell slightly in the first quarter of the year despite robust growth in the sector, the Confederation of British Industry said on Monday.
The CBI's latest pay databank survey showed pay awards averaged 3.7 percent in the period compared with 3.8 percent in the fourth quarter of last year and 3.5 percent in the first quarter of 1996.

Awards in the manufacturing sector remain broadly stable in the first quarter, averaging 3.2 percent for the period, unchanged from the three months to December and down 3.5 percent from the first quarter last year.
"Just under four in ten manufacturers said their inability to raise prices was keeping down pay awards, up a third from the previous survey," the survey said.
